title: Neon Static — System Gateway starter demonstration

source.timestampPrecision: Approximate navigation anchors; Jinteki log observations sampled every 10 seconds. They are not wall-clock action times.

format: 34/30-card starter decks; players explicitly announce a 6-point target

reproduction.level: verified normalized full-game reconstruction with annotated source ledger
reproduction.unknownPolicy: null or an explicit gap; never silently fill hidden cards, randomness or omitted actions
reproduction.coverage: Opening through recorded game ending. Public action order and credit/point effects are annotated; this is not a native engine decision replay.
reproduction.fullGameQualification: Legal reconstruction with explicit source corrections, synthetic hidden-state completion and controlled random outcomes. Not a literal original-shuffle reproduction.

issues.text: All three installed cards are identified by the first run. Their exact installation order is uncertain from the caption placement references; listed per-click identities are a possible ordering only. The resulting Remote 1 contains Tithe, Regolith and Manegarm.

Only two Sure Gambles and a Telework install are narrated, then the turn ends. A missing click or physical click-accounting error remains. The next spoken 15-credit checkpoint agrees with no extra credit action.
Mayfly is used during R5 and belongs in the heap at that run end. The physical reminder occurs early C6; it is not another game action.

No original deck shuffle or complete Corp hand/draw history. Some R&D accesses, two discards, the HQ ice and an unaccessed late remote remain unidentified. Their identities must remain unknown or become labelled synthetic completions in an engine fixture.
